summary: Draganfly Inc., a Canadian foreign private issuer, filed a Form 6-K attaching a Canadian Material Change Report disclosing completion of a US-only public offering of 1,869,159 common shares at US$5.35 for gross proceeds of roughly US$10 million. Pricing and closing were announced September 28-29, 2026, under an automatically effective Form F-10 shelf and October 24, 2025 base shelf prospectus, with no Canadian purchasers. Jett Capital Advisors and Northland Capital Markets served as joint-lead placement agents. Proceeds fund advanced strategic capability development and working capital. This is a routine shelf takedown, not a special situation.
